title: dashlint SDK descriptor
description: What one analytics SDK's calls mean, as data (spec 6.3.3): the members that send events, super properties, person properties and identity, matched by their resolved declaration (spec 6.4 item 3). Rules the schema cannot express (one role per call, members present in the stub) are checked by src/descriptors/loader.ts.

sdk.description: The descriptor id, used in catalogs.

package.description: The npm package an app imports.

versions.description: The version range this descriptor applies to: space-separated comparators, all of which must hold.

verified.description: The version whose published types and source every member and builtin was checked against (V1, V2).

declaredIn.description: Packages whose declaration files may declare the matched members.

platforms.description: Default platforms of a source using this SDK.

init.description: Where the app creates the client and passes the init options that builtin conditions read (spec 6.4 item 8).

builtins.description: The builtins file, relative to this descriptor.

ingestion.description: Properties the vendor adds on ingestion, whatever the SDK sends (ADR-029): a builtins file, relative to this descriptor, whose conditions are always or unknown. Its rows join the SDK's builtins.

stub.description: The type stub used when the package is not installed, relative to this descriptor.

unknownNames.description: Name prefixes the SDK or the platform may send that cannot be cited as builtins (ADR-003): a requirement on such a name is not checked, never dead.

container.description: A class or interface name, optionally followed by property names whose type is an object type (`PostHog.people`), or `(module)` for a function (or a `const` of a function type) declared at module level.

argPath.description: A call argument by position, optionally followed by object keys: `args[0]`, `args[1].$set`.

member.description: The method, or `constructor` for `new`, matched by its resolved declaration.

options.description: The options argument, or several positions of which the last one the call passes holds them (`init(key, options)` and `init(key, userId, options)`).

component.description: A component that creates the client; one given a `client` prop is not an init.

options.description: The prop that holds the init options.

member.description: The method or property name, matched by its resolved declaration.

hook.description: A function returning the client; members called on its result are matched as above.

event.description: Where the event name comes from: an argument, or a fixed name.

properties.description: The properties argument, or several merged in order (a later key overwrites an earlier one).

objectForm.description: The same member called with an event object instead of a name (Amplitude's `track({ event_type })`): used when the argument `event` reads from has an object type.

event.description: The key of the event object that holds the name: `args[0].event_type`.

addProperties.description: Properties the SDK adds to the event from other arguments.

personSetFallback.description: When the object at `personSet` is absent, the SDK sets the keys of `from` (less `omit`) instead.
